name: Grove Road Playing Field Play Area
text: Tiptree Parish Council's play area at Grove Road Playing Field, Tiptree, for all ages, next to a skate park, with toilets and a small car park; no dogs.

name: Thyme Road Play Area
text: Tiptree Parish Council's small play area behind the library on Thyme Road, Tiptree, with accessible play equipment.

name: Caxton Close Play Area
text: Tiptree Parish Council's accessible play area on Caxton Close, Tiptree, for children aged 4 to 11, beside an open amenity area; no dogs.
